label: Sunrise Porch
feel: A quiet porch facing east, watching the sky wake up.

lesson.title: Why is sunrise pink and orange?
lesson.fact: At sunrise, sunlight travels through a lot of air to reach your eyes. The air scatters away the blue light, so the reds, pinks, and oranges are what's left for us to see!
lesson.question: Why do sunrises look pink and orange instead of blue?
choices: Blue light gets scattered away by the air
lesson.successMessage: Yes! Sunlight has to pass through more sky at sunrise, so only the warm colors make it through.

lesson.title: Why do roosters crow at dawn?
lesson.fact: Roosters have an internal clock tied to light. As the sky starts to brighten, that clock tells them it's time to greet the new day!
lesson.question: What tells a rooster it's time to crow?
choices: Its internal clock reacting to light
lesson.successMessage: Right! Animals have internal clocks too, tuned to sunrise and sunset.
